newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo set to unveil black empowerment deal.
newsitem.headline: Anglo set to unveil black empowerment deal.

text.p: South Africa's largest firm, Anglo American Corp, was expected to announce a landmark advance for black economic empowerment on Wednesday with the sale of its 48 percent stake in Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd.
Anglo said it would hold a joint news conference with the National Empowerment Consortium (NEC), representing 50 black economic interest groups, at 1500 GMT.

The announcement followed intense speculation that the two sides had finally reached agreement, after months of negotiations, for the NEC to buy the controlling stake in the powerful industrial holding company.
Johnnic's assets include substantial stakes in leading concerns such as South African Breweries, Toyota South Africa, Premier Group and Times Media.
Anglo's 48 percent share in the concern is worth some 4.2 billion rand ($930 million).
